title: Tunisian Arepa Calzone
description: A twist on the classic Italian dish, this Tunisian Arepa Calzone combines Tunisian spices with the crispy texture of arepas.

ingredients.name: calzone filling
ingredients.notes: a mix of mozzarella, ricotta, and parmesan cheese

instructions: Brush the arepas with olive oil and bake for 10 minutes.
Spoon the calzone filling onto one half of each arepa.
Fold the other half over the filling and press down gently.
Place the calzones on a baking sheet and bake for an additional 5 minutes.
Drizzle with jazzy sauce and sprinkle with tunisian spice blend.
